notes: Page styles are Lochinvar water-heater/boiler styles, shown on the Cadet page with Cadet examples. Page states the styles were used across Lochinvar brands with specific model/series types, but no per-brand reuse is claimed here and no usesStylesOf is set. SHIPPED styles are those whose year (and month/week, where shipped) is stated in retrievable page text. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter) and page Style 7 (5 Y013 / 6 S1064 / 11 AA0365: year = 2nd or 2nd-3rd letter(s), month = 1st or 1st-2nd digit(s)) — both year letters live only in chart images, so no year can be encoded from text; see report for image-pass items. Page Styles 3, 4, 5, 6 ship YEAR-ONLY: their year digits are text-verified and only the month letter is chart-only, per precedent. All shipped examples are the page's own example serials; expected values are derived from the page's stated positions, not page-stated worked decodes (the page states positions, not a worked year/month for these examples).

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. yearFloor 2011 reflects the stated 2011 start, so a pre-2011 two-digit year cannot match this style.
